title: LaserPecker 2 Pro – Compact Handheld Laser Engraver
excerpt: The LaserPecker 2 Pro is a compact yet powerful handheld laser engraver capable of high‑speed and high‑precision engraving on a wide range of materials.
body:
## Overview The LaserPecker 2 Pro is a compact and versatile laser engraver designed for creators, hobbyists and small businesses who want professional‑level results in a portable format. Unlike traditional bulky machines, this handheld engraver focuses on mobility, ease of use and speed, making it ideal for both beginners and experienced makers. ## Performance & Speed One of the standout features of the LaserPecker 2 Pro is its speed. Using dual‑lens galvanometer technology, it can reach engraving speeds of up to 600 mm/s, with preview speeds up to 3750 mm/s. This allows you to quickly position designs and significantly reduce working time. ## Precision & Detail The machine offers a very fine laser spot of approximately 0.05 × 0.05 mm. This small spot size, combined with the dual‑lens system, allows for extremely detailed engraving, making it possible to reproduce complex designs with sharp clarity and high accuracy. ## Materials & Versatility The LaserPecker 2 Pro is capable of engraving a wide range of materials, including: - Wood - Leather - Paper and cardboard - Acrylic - Anodized or painted aluminum - Stainless steel (marking) This versatility makes it suitable for projects such as custom gifts, branding, crafts and prototyping. ## 360° Rotary Engraving With the optional electric roller, the LaserPecker 2 Pro supports 360° rotary engraving. This makes it possible to engrave cylindrical objects such as glasses, bottles, pens and tubes, greatly expanding the creative possibilities. ## Ease of Use The machine is designed to be accessible and beginner‑friendly: - No complex assembly required - Quick setup in seconds - Works with both smartphone and PC - Simple and intuitive software interface This makes it easy to get started immediately, even with no prior experience. ## Practical Applications The LaserPecker 2 Pro is ideal for: - Personalized gifts - Product branding - Small business production - Creative DIY projects Its portability also allows you to work directly on larger objects that cannot be moved easily. ## Image Gallery
